source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: When the opposing player's **[Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase)** reaches its **Battle-shock step**, each enemy unit within 12" of any of your **ANATHEMA PSYKANA** models must make a **Battle-shock** test when it is a **PSYKER** unit or has dropped below its **Starting Strength**. A unit **Below Half-strength** instead applies -1 to that test in this phase. As the designer's note explains, every enemy PSYKER unit and every enemy unit missing models within the aura's range is tested, not only units Below Half-strength.
